subset.rationale: absl::StatusOr<T> bound as three real specializations (int/std::string/double): ok(), status() (returns const Status& so Status+StatusCode are bound in-module), IgnoreError(), and value() -- bound HEAD-ON through its using-redeclaration from the PRIVATE internal_statusor::OperatorBase<T> base via entity-proxy support (BINDER-0009, -fentity-proxy-reflection; found+fixed TC-0003: three toolchain bugs around entity proxies). All of StatusOr's value/converting CONSTRUCTORS are templates (enable_if'd U&&), which the binder skips by design, so the sotest fixture namespace supplies ok_*/err_* factories (the Duration/Time pattern); get_* accessors remain as a differential cross-check channel.
skipped_features: operator*/operator-> re-exports (unary deref has no Python dunder; value() is the access path)
value construction/assignment from Python literals (all converting ctors are templates; factories instead)
value_or/emplace/AssignStatus (member templates needing explicit args or packs; Assign* re-exports have template underlyings -- skipped by design)
rvalue-ref-qualified &&-overloads (filtered via the binder-spec completeness gate; the decl predicate misreports through proxies, see TC-0003 addendum)
